note: Authoritative tag vocabulary. build_catalog.py rejects any tag not listed here and embeds this registry in the catalog; the MCP server, tools, and tests all read it from there. Topic tags are editorial metadata assigned by this project (title keyword rules, curated overrides in curated_edges.json, and schedule inheritance) - they are not classifications published by the IRS.

audience_tags.individual: Filed by or for individual taxpayers.
audience_tags.business: Filed by businesses, exempt organizations, trusts, or estates.
audience_tags.information: Information returns filed by third parties (payers, brokers, employers).
audience_tags.procedural: Administrative and procedural forms (applications, elections, authorizations).
audience_tags.guidance: Instructions, publications, and other IRS guidance documents.
audience_tags.retired: Forms no longer issued by the IRS, kept for historical lineage.

core-return.description: Primary annual returns that schedules and other forms attach to or flow into.

retirement.description: Forms related to retirement accounts (IRA, 401k, pension, Trump Accounts), distributions, and retirement-related credits.

healthcare.description: Forms related to health coverage reporting, HSAs, Archer MSAs, and ACA marketplace insurance and premium tax credits.

gambling.description: Forms used to report gambling winnings and withholding on gambling proceeds.

international.description: Forms for foreign income, foreign tax credits, disclosure of foreign accounts and entities, nonresident aliens, and tax treaties.

withholding.description: Forms related to federal income tax withholding by employers, payers, or on foreign payments.

self-employment.description: Forms related to self-employment income, sole proprietorships, freelance income, and related deductions.

employment-taxes.description: Forms for reporting, depositing, and reconciling payroll and employment taxes (FICA, FUTA).

tips-overtime.description: Forms reporting tip and overtime income, including the OBBBA qualified tips and overtime deductions on Schedule 1-A.

real-estate.description: Forms related to real property transactions, rental income, mortgage interest, and like-kind exchanges.

farming.description: Forms related to farm income, farm rental, and agricultural activity.

investments.description: Forms for interest, dividends, capital gains and losses, digital assets, net investment income, and Opportunity Zone investments.

estate-gift.description: Forms for estate and gift tax returns and related filings.

trusts-estates.description: Returns and forms related to trusts, estates, and fiduciary income reporting.

exempt-organizations.description: Returns and forms filed by tax-exempt organizations (nonprofits, charities, foundations).

charitable-contributions.description: Forms for reporting and substantiating charitable contributions.

excise-tax.description: Forms for reporting federal excise taxes on fuel, vehicles, alcohol, tobacco, and other taxable goods.

credits.description: Forms for claiming federal tax credits, refundable and nonrefundable (education, child, energy, earned income, etc.).

deductions.description: Forms for claiming itemized or above-the-line deductions.

depreciation.description: Forms for claiming depreciation and amortization deductions on business and investment property.

partnerships.description: Returns and schedules specific to partnerships and their partners' shares of income.

s-corporations.description: Returns and schedules specific to S corporations and their shareholders' shares of income.

c-corporations.description: Returns and forms specific to C corporations and corporate income tax.

qualified-business-income.description: Forms for calculating and claiming the Section 199A Qualified Business Income (QBI) deduction.

renewable-energy.description: Forms for claiming credits related to clean energy vehicles, residential energy improvements, and renewable energy production.

education.description: Forms related to tuition, student loans, and education credits or savings.

debt-cancellation.description: Forms reporting cancellation of debt and its exclusion from income.

government-payments.description: Forms reporting payments from government entities (unemployment compensation, state tax refunds).

alternative-minimum-tax.description: Forms for the alternative minimum tax, a parallel calculation that limits certain deductions and preferences.

estimated-tax.description: Forms for computing or paying estimated tax.

filing-procedures.description: Forms for filing extensions, amended returns, and electronic-filing authorization.
